answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce a novel task Quantitative Query-Focused Summarization (QQSUM), which generates comprehensive answers containing diverse KPs along with their quantified relative importance
answer_1.outputs: bullet-point KP-based summaries with quantified viewpoints

answer_2.quote: We first perform a lexical comparison between KPs in the generated summary and the ground truth by computing the highest Rouge score between generated and reference KPs for each query and then average the maxima

answer_3.quote: we compute precision and recall by prompting gpt-4-o-mini to annotate pairwise match/nonmatch between generated KPs and retrieved comments

answer_4.quote: We conducted pairwise comparisons of KPs from different systems using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk)
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed pairwise comparisons based on seven dimensions: REDUNDANCY, COVERAGE, FAITHFULNESS, VALIDITY, SENTIMENT, INFORMATIVENESS, SINGLE ASPECT
